scaffold._discoveryPainPoints:
1. [ProcessHandoffFriction] 90 minutes of unpaid administrative work required after each job completion (intensity 9/10, stage: Invoice Generation) ← flagged as binding
2. [ProcessHandoffFriction] Delayed invoicing causing cash flow problems equivalent to one month's revenue annually (intensity 8/10, stage: Invoice Generation) ← flagged as binding
3. [DataSignalFriction] No visibility into business performance patterns and profitable client segments (intensity 7/10, stage: Insight Generation)
4. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] Cold start problem with AI having no data on day one (intensity 6/10, stage: Initial Data Mapping)
5. [IncentiveCapacityFriction] High AI running costs for continuous background processing at scale (intensity 7/10, stage: Overnight Data Scanning)
